meta.title: File:Cathedral Fribourg bells ringing 01.ogg
meta.desc: St. Nicholas Cathedral in Fribourg, Switzerland, rings in Sunday with the full peal of bells on Saturday evening. The full peal consists of 13 bells. Together with the bells of the St. Gallen Cathedral and the Berner Münster, it is one of the most important historical large bells in Switzerland.

meta.title: File:Stiftskirche SG geläut.wav
meta.desc: The full ringing of the abbatial of St. Gallen includes 12 bells, 9 of which belong to the actual cathedral peal. The Trinity Bell (around 8100 kg, cast in 1768) produces the lowest bell tone in Switzerland. You can hear the end of ringing (the last approx. 90 seconds) of the full ringing (without the lowest bell) on Saturdays at 5.30 pm.
